DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, September 10, 2018 Posted by admin on September 10th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include UnitedHealth (UNH). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +75 points.
Friday the Dow was down -79.33 (-0.31%) at 25,916.54.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +4.84%.
There were 10 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Exxon Mobil (XOM) +1.70% and Pfizer (PFE) +1.01%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Intel (INTC) -1.70% and Travelers (TRV) -1.30%.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is unchanged at $2.847 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
There are no Dow stocks set to report earnings in the near term.
